_purpose: Single source of truth for verdict-name + design-only semantics. Consumed by BOTH scripts/verdict_gate.ps1 (PowerShell) and tools/lint_cards.py (Python). Do not inline a second copy of either pattern anywhere: a second copy is exactly how the PROTECTED 5->6 drift happened (EVO-20261114-002 / XJ-20261114-001). NOTE (EVO-20261121-001): design_only_pattern is a CONTENT scan pattern (not a file-name suffix); the file-name suffix classes live in suffixes[] above. The historical .design(-only)?$ file-name form was never in this contract.
_how_to_register_a_new_suffix: Add an entry to suffixes[] with the narrowest pattern that matches your file names, then re-run: python -m unittest tests.test_verdict_suffixes tests.test_verdict_gate_hardening (and the 138-card gate snapshot). Never widen a pattern to cover multiple styles at once.

_classes.canonical: the card's own verdict file, id MUST equal the base card id
_classes.stage: per-stage verdict (P3 / P4 / P6 / PR4-Afollow1 / P3-C1 ...), id MUST equal the full filename stem
_classes.single: single-letter stage shorthand (-A / -B / -C), id MUST equal the base card id
_classes.topic: thematic sub-verdict (.glasspill / .glassdesk / .round2 / .main-merge), id MUST equal the base card id

_design_only_field: EVO-20261121-001: a verdict's explicit boolean field `design_only` is AUTHORITATIVE when present (true = design/spec-only, never authorizes a code merge; false = explicit merge-authorization deliverable, overrides a content-scan false positive). When the field is ABSENT, both gate and lint fall back to the content scan above (keeps the 3 legacy design cards' marks with zero verdict edits). The field is a protected item-1 (verdict field semantics) touch.
_design_only_case: EVO-20261121-001: false -> PowerShell -match / Python re.IGNORECASE (case-insensitive, matches gate's historical default); true -> PowerShell -cmatch / Python re with no flag (case-sensitive). Key is REQUIRED and must be a bool; missing/non-bool is fail-closed in both consumers.
